desc: Ideation: select subset-construction DFA over the 16 binary relations as the primary approach.
Derive the transition relation on states {0,1} for every allowed d_i (0..2 if s_i=0, 0..3 if s_i=1), and document why d_N is uniquely determined by the cycle digits.
Precompute for s=0 and s=1 the next state and multiplicity for each of the 16 relation states, merging different d_i values that lead to the same next state and handling the empty/dead relation.
Implement the O(N) DP with a length-16 array initialized to the identity relation, process the input string character by character using the precomputed transitions, and take modulo 998244353.
Sum the DP values of states containing (0,0) or (1,1) and print the result as the number of distinct full in-degree sequences.
Optimize for N=10^6 using fast input, sparse transition lists, and batched modulo operations; verify on the provided samples and simple edge cases such as all zeros and all ones.
